subject: Streamly: Hosted API commit scale and limited rate-limit exemption
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@streamly.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: 3-month staged commit increase and limited launch-day rate exemption

Hi Sara,

Great chatting this morning. Attached is a refreshed proposal (Streamly_commit_proposal_v3.pdf) that outlines a 3-month staged increase to your hosted API monthly commit, plus a short, automatic burst allowance during your Q1 product launch week. High level:

- Month 1: bump to 2.5M tokens/month (discounted rate tier 2)
- Month 2: 4.0M tokens/month (tier 3 pricing)
- Month 3 onwards: 6.5M tokens/month (committed rate + burst pool)

We can provision a temporary rate-limit carveout (up to 3x baseline rate for a 72-hour launch window) provided we get the commitment in place and a signed amendment before launch. I also included a proposed schedule for the commit stair in the attached commit_schedule.xlsx.

Quick Qs for you before I loop in procurement: target launch date, and do you want the burst window to be a single contiguous 72-hr carveout or three separate 24-hr windows?

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafel.mendes@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

---
Attachment: Streamly_commit_proposal_v3.pdf (proposal summary, pricing table)

From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@streamly.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Streamly Procurement <procurement@streamly.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-month staged commit increase and limited launch-day rate exemption

Thanks Rafael — this looks promising. A few clarifying items from our side:

1) Can you confirm whether the burst allowance is charged at the same per-token rate or at a premium?
2) We need assurances around rate-limiter behavior during the burst (do requests queue, fail, or get routed to a fallback model?).
3) Procurement will need a line-item pricing table and a PDF-friendly amendment for e-sign.

Target launch is currently Jan 18, 2028 (tentative). We prefer a single contiguous 72-hr launch carveout.

Looping in procurement to start the paperwork.

—Sara
Head of Product, Streamly

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@streamly.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Team <streamly-dev@streamly.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-month staged commit increase and limited launch-day rate exemption

Hi Sara — Marissa from Solutions here. Quick technical clarifications:

- Burst billing: burst tokens are billed against the committed rate band (no premium) up to the burst pool cap. We only charge above committed quantity once the burst pool and monthly commit are exhausted.
- Behavior: during a carveout we temporarily raise the per-second RPS limit for your tenant and enable graceful queuing; we will not silently route to a lower-quality fallback unless you request automatic fallback.
- Observability: we'll give you a dedicated dashboard view for the 72-hr window and a post-launch traffic report.

If you want, we can run a simulated burst test in a staging window to validate integration — takes ~30 minutes of engineering time.

Best,
Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
(Note: internal engineering contact is streamly-dev@streamly.com for rate-limit tuning during staging)
